title: AI Selfie Generator
summary: Free AI selfie generator: make realistic phone selfies of an original character or from your photo, on a summit, a neon street, a beach or in anime style.
body_markdown:
### Is there a free AI selfie generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every selfie on this page, costs 5 credits an image at its default settings.


### How do I make an AI selfie of myself?


Add a clear, front-facing photo of yourself as a reference image, then describe a selfie of the same person in a new place, naming the features to keep, such as your hair, glasses and smile.


### How do I make an AI selfie look real?


Describe the phone camera as well as the person: an arm's length angle, slight wide-angle distortion, natural skin texture and one real light source, such as the low sun, a flash or neon signs.


### Can I make a selfie in a different style, like anime or film?


Yes. Name the style in the prompt, such as 1990s cel anime, a Polaroid, a disposable camera flash or a soft focus film portrait, and the same selfie is drawn or shot in that look.


### Can I keep the same face across many AI selfies?


Yes. Add the first selfie or your photo as a reference image to each new prompt; GPT Image 2.6 takes up to 10 reference images, so you can add a few angles of one face.


### Can I make a selfie with a friend or a group?


Yes. Describe each person with a few clear features, or add a photo of each as a reference, and ask for them all squeezed into one arm's length selfie.


### Can I turn an AI selfie into a video?


Yes. Use the selfie as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one small movement, such as a laugh, a wave or hair blowing in the wind, and ask it to keep the face as it is.
